short: A European multinational twin-engine, canard delta wing, multirole fighter.
full:
The Eurofighter Typhoon entered operational service in August 2003, developed by a consortium of British, German, Italian, and Spanish aerospace companies. Designed during the late Cold War as a highly agile air superiority fighter to counter Soviet aircraft, its aerodynamic instability is managed by a computerized fly-by-wire system, granting it exceptional maneuverability and performance at supersonic speeds.

The aircraft evolved significantly after the Cold War, integrating advanced air-to-ground capabilities to serve as a versatile multirole platform. It forms the backbone of several European air forces and has been exported to nations in the Middle East. The Typhoon has seen combat operations over Libya, Iraq, and Syria, performing combat air patrols and precision ground strikes.
